## What this changes

Which day/phase, and what specifically — a brief's wording, a test, tooling, docs.

## Why

The reasoning, not just the diff — especially important if this touches a brief's
explanation rather than its code (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Checklist

- [ ] `mvn -q -pl <phase-module> test` passes locally
- [ ] Scoped to one day/one concern
- [ ] If this changes a brief's claim or explanation, I've noted a source or reasoning above
